TORNE ISSO REAL, MANTENHA SÓ RETIRE CORES DOS BOTÕES DE PENDENTE E EM EXECUÇÃO E CONCLUÍDO, NOS ITENS CONCLUÍDOS RETIRE A COR DO FUNDO DO CARD E DÊ HIDE DE 30% NAS DEMAIS INFORMAÇÕES. You can hotlink images from the html.
MANTENHA EXATAMENTE AS MESMAS PROPORÇÕES, CORES E DEMAIS INFORMAÇÕES EXISTENTES.
PARA CONTEXTUALIZAR: 
é um app para report de eventos, onde é necessário tirar fotos de todos os itens ou serviços contratados. um forte aliado para o produtor de eventos que precisa lembrar de tirar fotos para criar relatório de execução.

por isso, preciso que você crie uma aplicação, web app, em que é incluído uma lista para que o usuário clique em cada um dos itens dessa lista, e ao clicar aparece a opção de incluir imagens, quantas ele quiser, o sistema mandará alertas para ele falando dos itens que está faltando incluir imagens. Ao receber a imagem, o sistema deve utilizar leitor de imagens para saber se a imagem retrata exatamente o diz o item. exemplo, na lista fala que são 3 recepcionistas (a imagem deve possuir 3 pessoas), caso não seja exatamente igual, sistema deve questionar se é para seguir assim mesmo e, se menos (só tem uma pessoa na imagem) deve falar para ele incluir as demais pessoas. O alerta deve sempre alertar a questão da quantidade, quando achar que cumpriu com o que precisa, o sistema deve apresentar relatório para o usuário sobre aquele item, e questionar se pode encerrar o item. Deve perguntar também, na hora do clique, se o usuário quer inserir data e local em que foi tirada a imagem (alimentados via backend juntamente com a planilha).

As fotos devem ser salvas em pasta no sharepoint que será indentificada pelo usuário na hora do upload da planilha.

Quando o usuário incluir imagem para todos os itens, deve emitir mensagem de parabéns, dizer que todos os itens foram incluídos que agora é só montar o RE com todo o material.


Entendi! Você precisa de um aplicativo para celular que ajude os produtores de eventos a gerenciar e reportar a execução dos eventos, garantindo que todas as fotos necessárias sejam tiradas.

Para começar, podemos projetar as seguintes telas para o seu aplicativo móvel:

Lista de Eventos: Uma tela onde o produtor pode ver uma lista de todos os eventos em andamento ou futuros.
Detalhes do Evento: Ao selecionar um evento, o usuário verá os detalhes e a lista de itens/serviços contratados para aquele evento.
Adicionar Fotos ao Item: Uma tela dedicada para um item específico, onde o usuário pode tirar fotos, ver as fotos já adicionadas e receber alertas.
Relatório de Item: Uma tela que mostra um resumo do item, incluindo as fotos e a opção de finalizar a verificação do item.

**Considering App Architecture**

I'm currently focused on the overarching architecture. My thought process revolves around creating a mobile-first React application for event reporting. I need to figure out the best way to structure the components to ensure a smooth user experience. I'm also considering the data flow and how it will interface with the API. The goal is to make it as simple and user-friendly as possible, while still providing robust functionality.


**Define Event Workflow**

I've been mapping out the event producer workflow in detail.  The core functionality is solidified: listing events, tracking items, photo uploads, AI verification (mimicking Gemini), discrepancy alerts, metadata tagging, and completion notifications. I'm prioritizing accuracy in replicating the provided HTML/Tailwind design.  Specifically, I'm focusing on the requested modifications to status badges and completed item displays, aiming for visual clarity.


**Outlining App Components**

I'm now fully immersed in the app's structural blueprint. I've decided on `lucide-react` for icons and am eschewing CSS files. The folder structure is taking shape with `index.html` loading Tailwind and Google Fonts. My entry point will be `index.tsx`, with `App.tsx` handling the routing. Types for key entities like `Event` and `Item` will live in `types.ts`, and `services/geminiService.ts` will house the Gemini API interactions. I'm focusing on components like `EventList`, `EventDetail`, `ItemDetail`, `ItemReport`, and `Login`. Realistic mock data for events is next on my to-do list.


**Planning Implementation Phases**

My focus has shifted towards a detailed, phase-by-phase implementation plan. I'm starting with setting up the project metadata and permissions, then moving through the HTML entry point and data types.  Next, I'll tackle the Gemini service integration, including crafting effective prompts for the AI, specifically tailored to the reporting needs. Component-wise, I'm starting with the Login and EventList, paying close attention to status badge and opacity requirements. I'm aware that ItemDetail presents a significant challenge. I'll need to figure out the file input without `react-dropzone`.


**Updating Status Badge Design**

I'm now fully immersed in the design, and focused on implementing the updated status badge styles requested. I've interpreted "retire cores" to mean removing the background color while keeping text color for semantic meaning. This adjustment is crucial for the visual coherence of the application and the logic implementation for the metadata toggles. I'm prioritizing accuracy in representing the status updates accurately and matching the desired visual aesthetic.


**Finalizing Item Displays**

I'm zeroing in on the display of completed items. I'm choosing a white background with a slate border and the original text colors, ensuring a consistent visual hierarchy. For the "hide" effect, I'm setting the opacity to 50% for clarity. With Gemini, I'm leaning toward `gemini-2.5-flash` for the image analysis prompt. My image upload strategy leverages the standard HTML file input, focusing on a mobile-friendly user experience.


**Refining Core Functionality**

I'm now implementing the core data structures and service interactions. I've defined `Item` and `Photo` interfaces and am configuring the Gemini service with a tailored image analysis prompt for discrepancies, returning JSON results.  In `App.tsx`, I'm managing states for the current view and events, with a `handlePhotoUpload` function that interfaces with Gemini. I'm focusing on the interaction and the accuracy of photo analysis.


**Integrating Updated Designs**

I'm now implementing the refined design specifics for the status badges and completed items. The "retire cores" instruction resulted in white backgrounds with slate borders for the updated badges. Completed items are now displayed with an opacity of 70% and a white background with a slate border. To mimic saving photos to SharePoint, I’m simulating this action with a `setTimeout`, while leaving a comment and service placeholder for backend integration, as I'm unable to connect to SharePoint directly. I'm focusing on consistency with the provided Tailwind styles.


**Implementing Final Visual Touches**

I'm now implementing the final tweaks to the design. Based on the feedback, I've adjusted the color scheme and opacity for a clean look.  I've set the status badges to be white with subtle borders and text, and implemented the requested opacity change to complete items.  Next, I will be adding the missing "Parabéns" message logic for when all items are done.  I'm focusing on user experience, and visual clarity with these last changes.

CHECKLIST DE VALIDAÇÃO:

1.  **Framework**: React 18+ com TypeScript (`.tsx`), Vite-compatible structure.
2.  **Estilização**: Tailwind CSS via CDN (conforme solicitado), usando a paleta Slate/Gray refinada das imagens.
3.  **Visual**:
    *   Fidelidade às imagens fornecidas (Layouts de Login, Lista, Detalhes, Item e Relatório).
    *   **Alteração Solicitada 1**: Botões de status (Pendente, Em Execução, Concluído) sem cores de fundo (estilo outline/neutro).
    *   **Alteração Solicitada 2**: Itens concluídos na lista sem cor de fundo e com opacidade reduzida (efeito "hide 30%").
4.  **Funcionalidade (Gemini AI)**:
    *   Integração simulada e preparada para o SDK `@google/genai`.
    *   Lógica: Upload de foto -> Análise de Quantidade/Contexto -> Alerta de Discrepância.
    *   Metadata: Toggles para Data/Local.
    *   Fluxo: Login -> Lista de Eventos -> Lista de Itens -> Upload/Câmera -> Validação IA -> Relatório -> Conclusão.
5.  **Regras de Negócio**:
    *   Verificação de quantidade (ex: 3 recepcionistas).
    *   Mensagem de "Parabéns" ao finalizar todos os itens.
    *   Mock de salvamento no SharePoint (interface apenas).

Posso seguir dessa forma?

I've been analyzing the application's photo overlay functionality. The goal is clear: ensure the metadata, including timestamp and geolocation, is visually present when the user toggles it on. I'm focusing on allowing for manual positioning, in addition to automatic placement, and am working on refining the implementation for optimal user experience.


**Refining Geolocation Options**

I'm now zeroing in on integrating manual geolocation input. The existing codebase hardcodes coordinates, and I need to replace that with a user-friendly way to input location data. My focus is on ensuring flexibility for users who may not have GPS enabled or accurate. I'm considering how best to integrate a text field for manual entry alongside the automatic GPS option within the `App.tsx` file to enhance the `ItemDetail` component. This will be crucial for complete functionality.


**Adding Flexible Display Options**

I'm currently working to expand the `ItemDetail` component. I'm focused on allowing users to provide their own location text for display in the photo overlay. I'm adding a `customLocation` state to capture this input. The Geolocation UI will change to show an input box when geolocation is selected, rather than a simple toggle. This integrates neatly with existing functionality. I'm ensuring the `processImage` function uses this custom input.


**Finalizing Display Logic**

I'm now fully immersed in the display logic. I've updated the `processImage` function to leverage `customLocation`. I'm also adding an overlay `div` to the photo mapping, ensuring that the timestamp and location, whether automatically generated or manually entered, display correctly at the bottom of each image. I've finalized the conditional input field that appears when the geolocation toggle is active within the metadata UI section. The focus now is on testing this extensively.


**Integrating the New Input**

I'm presently focused on adding the input field for custom location text. I've integrated a conditional display of the input box within the existing `App.tsx` file, specifically linking it to the geolocation toggle's state. I'm now testing how the `customLocation` state integrates with the larger system, and ensuring that input is accepted. I've updated the relevant sections of the UI to accommodate this new feature. I'm working with the XML file to ensure that the input field works as expected.


**Completing Validation Checks**

I'm presently completing the validation checklist to ensure all project goals are met. The visual overlay, manual location entry, and integration with the existing `processImage` function are all confirmed. **Considering the UI Shift**

I'm currently focused on the overarching objective: revising the Valiant Report UI. I've begun to break down the required changes, pinpointing UI aspects that need attention. My initial considerations involve assessing existing components to determine where alterations are most strategically applied. The existing UI's structure is a key point of consideration.


**Examining Data Structure**

My focus is shifting to data extraction. I'm analyzing the OCR text provided to structure a list of `Item` objects. The existing PDF content will guide the creation of event details. Key elements like description, quantity, and daily rates are the immediate target for parsing.


**Refining Data Mapping**

My current thinking centers around refining the data mapping strategy for the extracted items. I'm focusing on assigning Material Symbols icons based on item categories or keywords. I've drafted some sample items, including `Cenografia`, `Mobiliário`, and `Equipamentos`, and I'm determining how to structure them as `Item` objects.


**Detailing New Item Categories**

I've been working on expanding the item list with these new categories. Currently, I'm integrating data related to "Brindes," "Gráfica," and "Têxtil." I'm also addressing the "Digital," "Foto," "Técnicos," "RH," and "Artísticos" categories. I'm focusing on ensuring these elements are appropriately mapped to corresponding `Item` objects, detailing specifications like quantities and descriptions, as seen in the new list.


**Incorporating Event Specifics**

I'm now integrating event-specific data. I'm focusing on the "Evento Institucional 2025" and considering the details such as "cerimônia," specific catering options ("Café almoço", "Café coq"), and other critical needs like an ambulance and medical post. I'm also planning to represent these as `Item` objects within the event structure, keeping in mind efficiency with a compressed data structure for the full range. My goal is to streamline the representation of these diverse needs.


**Integrating Event-Specific Data**

I'm now diving into the code. My focus is on dynamically loading the correct item list based on the user's selected event. I'm implementing `getEventItems(eventId: string)` to fetch data. For the existing mock events, it'll use the existing mock data, while the new CAIXA event will leverage the PDF data. I'm planning to modify `handleSelectEvent` to update both the selected event and the displayed items using `setItems(getEventItems(evt.id))`. Finally, I'm switching to a select box for filtering items in the UI.


**Adjusting UI for Filtering**

I'm now integrating the event-filtering feature in the UI, focusing on the select box. I'm focusing on modifying the select box for filtering items, ensuring it correctly displays all, pending, ongoing, and completed events. My work includes using Material Symbols for visual cues.

**Developing the Event UI**

I'm presently building the new UI components to display event-specific data. I've integrated a new item, "Credenciamento imprensa/chapelaria," using relevant properties like name, description, required quantity, status, and icon. I’m thinking of a helper function to keep the component tidy. I'm focusing on the visual presentation and making the dropdown match existing styles, and inserting the CAIXA image URL. The logo remains large, the dropdown replaces the tabs, and upon accessing the new event, the `items` state refreshes to display the CAIXA items.


**Consolidating Item Data**

I'm now focusing on condensing and integrating the item data to fit within the constraints while covering all categories from the OCR text. I will create a function to generate initial items for events. The original format's length is a concern, so I will attempt to accurately represent all categories, potentially combining similar items, while still keeping the list within code limit constraints. I'm also ensuring the use of the provided image URL. The UI now utilizes a styled native select box for event filtering, replacing the previous horizontal scroll. Additionally, I am ensuring the event title reflects "Evento Institucional 2025."


**Crafting Event Structure**

I'm presently building the `App.tsx` component, focusing on incorporating the "Evento de líderes CX" data. I'm condensing the `Items` array to represent key categories: Cenografia, Mobiliário, Equipamentos, Brindes, and RH. This includes details like date, location, and specific event items, ensuring a balance between data accuracy and code efficiency. My goal is to create a clear and compact data structure for the event within the constraints.

    *   **Descrição:** Evento de líderes CX.
    *   **Data:** 16 e 17/12.

I'm focusing on dynamically showing/hiding categories based on item counts to keep the UI clean. Next, I'll tackle adding the "Base" upload feature to the menu. The core plan is now set, and I'm ready to move into the implementation phase.


**Integrating Base File Logic**

I'm currently working to integrate the "Base" file upload functionality. My focus is on creating a realistic simulation, given the constraints of a purely frontend mock. I've defined a `handleBaseUpload` function that, when triggered, will update the `CAIXA_ITEMS` state with pre-defined mock data to simulate file parsing. The UI will then render the categories dynamically based on the available items in this updated list, enhancing the user experience.


**Revising Category Accuracy**

I'm now focusing on a critical step: ensuring the category list is fully accurate to the specified table. **Clarifying File Interactions**

I'm now fully immersed in the mechanics of the file upload feature. My focus is centered on a hidden file input element triggered by a menu item.  The `onChange` event will simulate file reading by setting the items state to a predetermined mock data.  I'm also paying close attention to ensuring that the `getCategoryIcon` function aligns with the strict category names, reflecting the new table structure.


**Finalizing Mock Data**

I've also finalized the icon mapping for each category, ensuring accurate representation.  The structure's in place, and I'm ready for final testing of the simulation.

I'm now integrating the category-specific icons, ensuring a precise match to the new, detailed category structure.   const completedCount = items.filter(i => i.status === 'Concluído').length;

  const [showCongrats, setShowCongrats] = useState(false);

  const [expandedCategories, setExpandedCategories] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  const [editDesc, setEditDesc] = useState(event.description);

  const headerInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const baseInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (progress === 100 && items.length > 0) {
        setShowCongrats(true);
    }
  }, [progress, items.length]);
  
  // Group items by category
  const groupedItems = items.reduce((acc, item) => {
      const cat = item.category || 'Outros';
      if (!acc[cat]) acc[cat] = [];
      acc[cat].push(item);
      return acc;
  }, {} as Record<string, Item[]>);

  const toggleCategory = (category: string) => {
      setExpandedCategories(prev => ({
          ...prev,
          [category]: !prev[category]
      }));
  };

  const handleHeaderImageUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
          const reader = new FileReader();
          reader.onloadend = () => {
              const base64 = reader.result as string;
              onUpdateEvent({ ...event, image: base64 });
              setShowMenu(false);
          };
          reader.readAsDataURL(e.target.files[0]);
      }
  };

const App = () => {
  const [view, setView] = useState<'login' | 'list' | 'detail' | 'item'>('login');
  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState<Event | null>(null);
  const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState<Item | null>(null);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<any>(null);

  // Initialize with EMPTY items (waiting for base upload) for the main event to demo the feature
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Item[]>([]);

  const handleLogin = () => {
      setUser({ name: 'Produtor', email: 'produtor@valiant.com' });
      setView('list');
  };
  
  const handleLogout = () => {
      setUser(null);
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('login');
  };

  const handleSelectEvent = (evt: Event) => {
      // Logic to switch items based on event ID
      if (evt.id === 'cx-2025') {
          // Initialize empty to show the "Load Base" feature
          setItems([]);
      } else {
          setItems(INITIAL_EMPTY_ITEMS);
      }
      setSelectedEvent(evt);
      setView('detail');
  };
  
  const handleUpdateEvent = (updatedEvent: Event) => {
      setSelectedEvent(updatedEvent);
      // In a real app, you would also update the list of events here
  };
  
  const handleUpdateItems = (newItems: Item[]) => {
      setItems(newItems);
  };

  const handleSelectItem = (item: Item) => {
      if (item.status === 'Concluído') return; 
      setSelectedItem(item);
      setView('item');
  };

  const handleUpdateItem = (updated: Item) => {
      const newItems = items.map(i => i.id === updated.id ? updated : i);
      setItems(newItems);
      setSelectedItem(updated);
  };

  const handleBackToDetail = () => {
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('detail');
  };

  const handleBackToList = () => {
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setView('list');
  };

  return (
    <div className="font-sans text-slate-900">
       {view === 'login' && <Login onLogin={handleLogin} />}
       {view === 'list' && <EventList onSelectEvent={handleSelectEvent} onLogout={handleLogout} />}
       {view === 'detail' && selectedEvent && (
           <EventDetail 
                event={selectedEvent} 
                items={items} 
                onBack={handleBackToList}
                onSelectItem={handleSelectItem}
                onUpdateEvent={handleUpdateEvent}
                onUpdateItems={handleUpdateItems}
           />
       )}
       {view === 'item' && selectedItem && (
           <ItemDetail 
                item={selectedItem} 
                onBack={handleBackToDetail}
                onUpdateItem={handleUpdateItem}
           />
       )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default App;

    const [includeTimestamp, setIncludeTimestamp] = useState(true);

    const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

    const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
            processImage(e.target.files[0]);
        }
    };

    const processImage = async (file: File) => {
        // Disabled AI analysis for now.
        // setAnalyzing(true);
        setDiscrepancyData(null);
        
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onloadend = async () => {
            const base64 = reader.result as string;
            // const cleanBase64 = base64.split(',')[1];
            // const result = await analyzeImage(cleanBase64, item.name, item.requiredQuantity);

            const newPhoto: Photo = {
                id: Date.now().toString(),
                url: base64,
                isVerified: true, // Auto verified since AI is disabled
                hasWarning: false,
                timestamp: includeTimestamp ? new Date().toLocaleString() : undefined,
                coords: includeGeo ? customLocation : undefined
            };

            const updatedPhotos = [...item.photos, newPhoto];
            
            onUpdateItem({
                ...item,
                photos: updatedPhotos,
                status: updatedPhotos.length >= 1 ? 'Análise' : 'Pendente'
            });
            
            // setAnalyzing(false);
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    };

    const handleFinishItem = () => {
        if (confirm("Deseja encerrar este item?")) {
            onUpdateItem({ ...item, status: 'Concluído' });
            onBack();
        }

    const handlePrevImage = () => {
        if (viewingPhotoIndex !== null && viewingPhotoIndex > 0) {
            setViewingPhotoIndex(viewingPhotoIndex - 1);
        }
    };

        if (viewingPhotoIndex !== null && viewingPhotoIndex < item.photos.length - 1) {
            setViewingPhotoIndex(viewingPhotoIndex + 1);

                                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-white text-[32px]">chevron_left</span>

                             <img 
                                src={viewingPhoto.url} 
                                className="max-h-[80vh] max-w-full object-contain rounded-lg shadow-2xl" 
                                alt="View"
                             />
                             
                             {/* OVERLAY MASK - Event Info, Location, Date */}

                                        <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">calendar_today</span>
                                        {viewingPhoto.timestamp || new Date().toLocaleString()}
                                     </span>
                                 </div>
                             </div>
                         </div>

                         {item.photos.length > 1 && (
                             <button 
                                onClick={handleNextImage}

                    onClick={handleFinishItem}
                    disabled={item.photos.length === 0}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-800 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-slate-900/10 hover:bg-slate-900 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:shadow-none transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                >
                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">check</span>
                    Salvar e Continuar
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// --- Main App Component ---

const App = () => {
  const [view, setView] = useState<'login' | 'list' | 'detail' | 'item'>('login');
  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState<Event | null>(null);
  const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState<Item | null>(null);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<any>(null);

  // Initialize with EMPTY items (waiting for base upload) for the main event to demo the feature
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Item[]>([]);

  const handleLogin = () => {
      setUser({ name: 'Produtor', email: 'produtor@valiant.com' });
      setView('list');
  };
  
  const handleLogout = () => {
      setUser(null);
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('login');
  };

  const handleSelectEvent = (evt: Event) => {
      // Logic to switch items based on event ID
      if (evt.id === 'cx-2025') {
          // Initialize empty to show the "Load Base" feature
          setItems([]);
      } else {
          setItems(INITIAL_EMPTY_ITEMS);
      }
      setSelectedEvent(evt);
      setView('detail');
  };
  
  const handleUpdateEvent = (updatedEvent: Event) => {
      setSelectedEvent(updatedEvent);
      // In a real app, you would also update the list of events here
  };
  
  const handleUpdateItems = (newItems: Item[]) => {
      setItems(newItems);
  };

  const handleSelectItem = (item: Item) => {
      if (item.status === 'Concluído') return; 
      setSelectedItem(item);
      setView('item');
  };

  const handleUpdateItem = (updated: Item) => {
      const newItems = items.map(i => i.id === updated.id ? updated : i);
      setItems(newItems);
      setSelectedItem(updated);
  };

  const handleBackToDetail = () => {
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('detail');
  };

  const handleBackToList = () => {
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setView('list');
  };

  return (
    <div className="font-sans text-slate-900">
       {view === 'login' && <Login onLogin={handleLogin} />}
       {view === 'list' && <EventList onSelectEvent={handleSelectEvent} onLogout={handleLogout} />}
       {view === 'detail' && selectedEvent && (
           <EventDetail 
                event={selectedEvent} 
                items={items} 
                onBack={handleBackToList}
                onSelectItem={handleSelectItem}
                onUpdateEvent={handleUpdateEvent}
                onUpdateItems={handleUpdateItems}
           />
       )}
       {view === 'item' && selectedItem && selectedEvent && (
           <ItemDetail 
                item={selectedItem} 
                event={selectedEvent}
                onBack={handleBackToDetail}
                onUpdateItem={handleUpdateItem}
           />
       )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default App;

const App = () => {
  const [view, setView] = useState<'login' | 'list' | 'detail' | 'item'>('login');
  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState<Event | null>(null);
  const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState<Item | null>(null);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<any>(null);

  // Initialize with EMPTY items (waiting for base upload) for the main event to demo the feature
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Item[]>([]);

  const handleLogin = () => {
      setUser({ name: 'Produtor', email: 'produtor@valiant.com' });
      setView('list');
  };
  
  const handleLogout = () => {
      setUser(null);
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('login');
  };

  const handleSelectEvent = (evt: Event) => {
      // Logic to switch items based on event ID
      if (evt.id === 'cx-2025') {
          // Initialize empty to show the "Load Base" feature
          setItems([]);
      } else {
          setItems(INITIAL_EMPTY_ITEMS);
      }
      setSelectedEvent(evt);
      setView('detail');
  };
  
  const handleUpdateEvent = (updatedEvent: Event) => {
      setSelectedEvent(updatedEvent);
      // In a real app, you would also update the list of events here
  };
  
  const handleUpdateItems = (newItems: Item[]) => {
      setItems(newItems);
  };

  const handleSelectItem = (item: Item) => {
      if (item.status === 'Concluído') return; 
      setSelectedItem(item);
      setView('item');
  };

  const handleUpdateItem = (updated: Item) => {
      const newItems = items.map(i => i.id === updated.id ? updated : i);
      setItems(newItems);
      setSelectedItem(updated);
  };

  const handleBackToDetail = () => {
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('detail');
  };

  const handleBackToList = () => {
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setView('list');
  };

  return (
    <div className="font-sans text-slate-900">
       {view === 'login' && <Login onLogin={handleLogin} />}
       {view === 'list' && <EventList onSelectEvent={handleSelectEvent} onLogout={handleLogout} />}
       {view === 'detail' && selectedEvent && (
           <EventDetail 
                event={selectedEvent} 
                items={items} 
                onBack={handleBackToList}
                onSelectItem={handleSelectItem}
                onUpdateEvent={handleUpdateEvent}
                onUpdateItems={handleUpdateItems}
           />
       )}
       {view === 'item' && selectedItem && selectedEvent && (
           <ItemDetail 
                item={selectedItem} 
                event={selectedEvent}
                onBack={handleBackToDetail}
                onUpdateItem={handleUpdateItem}
           />
       )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default App;

  const groupedItems = items.reduce((acc, item) => {
      const cat = item.category || 'Outros';
      if (!acc[cat]) acc[cat] = [];
      acc[cat].push(item);
      return acc;
  }, {} as Record<string, Item[]>);

  const sortedCategories = Object.entries(groupedItems).sort(([catA], [catB]) => {
      if (catA === 'Outros') return 1;
      if (catB === 'Outros') return -1;
      return catA.localeCompare(catB);

const App = () => {
  const [view, setView] = useState<'login' | 'list' | 'detail' | 'item'>('login');
  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState<Event | null>(null);
  const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState<Item | null>(null);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<any>(null);

  // Initialize with EMPTY items (waiting for base upload) for the main event to demo the feature
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Item[]>([]);

  const handleLogin = () => {
      setUser({ name: 'Produtor', email: 'produtor@valiant.com' });
      setView('list');
  };
  
  const handleLogout = () => {
      setUser(null);
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('login');
  };

  const handleSelectEvent = (evt: Event) => {
      // Logic to switch items based on event ID
      if (evt.id === 'cx-2025') {
          // Initialize empty to show the "Load Base" feature
          setItems([]);
      } else {
          setItems(INITIAL_EMPTY_ITEMS);
      }
      setSelectedEvent(evt);
      setView('detail');
  };
  
  const handleUpdateEvent = (updatedEvent: Event) => {
      setSelectedEvent(updatedEvent);
      // In a real app, you would also update the list of events here
  };
  
  const handleUpdateItems = (newItems: Item[]) => {
      setItems(newItems);
  };

  const handleSelectItem = (item: Item) => {
      if (item.status === 'Concluído') return; 
      setSelectedItem(item);
      setView('item');
  };

  const handleUpdateItem = (updated: Item) => {
      const newItems = items.map(i => i.id === updated.id ? updated : i);
      setItems(newItems);
      setSelectedItem(updated);
  };

  const handleBackToDetail = () => {
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('detail');
  };

  const handleBackToList = () => {
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setView('list');
  };

  return (
    <div className="font-sans text-slate-900">
       {view === 'login' && <Login onLogin={handleLogin} />}
       {view === 'list' && <EventList onSelectEvent={handleSelectEvent} onLogout={handleLogout} />}
       {view === 'detail' && selectedEvent && (
           <EventDetail 
                event={selectedEvent} 
                items={items} 
                onBack={handleBackToList}
                onSelectItem={handleSelectItem}
                onUpdateEvent={handleUpdateEvent}
                onUpdateItems={handleUpdateItems}
           />
       )}
       {view === 'item' && selectedItem && selectedEvent && (
           <ItemDetail 
                item={selectedItem} 
                event={selectedEvent}
                onBack={handleBackToDetail}
                onUpdateItem={handleUpdateItem}
           />
       )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default App;

// 4. Item Detail & Camera Component
const ItemDetail = ({ item, event, onBack, onUpdateItem }: { item: Item, event: Event, onBack: () => void, onUpdateItem: (updated: Item) => void }) => {
    // analyzing state removed from UI usage basically
    const [includeTimestamp, setIncludeTimestamp] = useState(true);
    const [includeGeo, setIncludeGeo] = useState(false);
    const [customLocation, setCustomLocation] = useState<string>("Salão Principal"); // Default manual location
    
    // UI States for Discrepancy
    const [discrepancyData, setDiscrepancyData] = useState<{count: number, reason: string} | null>(null);

    // Image Viewer State
    const [viewingPhotoIndex, setViewingPhotoIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

    const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

    const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
            processImage(e.target.files[0]);
        }
    };
    
    // Função para obter GPS se necessário
    const getGPSCoordinates = (): Promise<string> => {
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            if (!navigator.geolocation) {
                resolve("GPS não suportado");
                return;
            }
            navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                (position) => {
                    resolve(`${position.coords.latitude.toFixed(5)}, ${position.coords.longitude.toFixed(5)}`);
                },
                (error) => {
                    resolve("Erro GPS");
                },
                { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 5000, maximumAge: 0 }
            );
        });
    };

    const processImage = async (file: File) => {
        setDiscrepancyData(null);
        
        // 1. Determine Location String based on User Preference
        let finalLocation = undefined;
        if (includeGeo) {
            if (customLocation.trim().length > 0) {
                // User typed something, use it
                finalLocation = customLocation;
            } else {
                // User didn't type, fetch GPS
                finalLocation = await getGPSCoordinates();
            }
        }
        
        // 2. Read File
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onloadend = async () => {
            const base64 = reader.result as string;

            const newPhoto: Photo = {
                id: Date.now().toString(),
                url: base64,
                isVerified: true, 
                hasWarning: false,
                timestamp: includeTimestamp ? new Date().toLocaleString() : undefined,
                coords: finalLocation
            };

            const updatedPhotos = [...item.photos, newPhoto];
            const newItemState = {
                ...item,
                photos: updatedPhotos,
                status: (updatedPhotos.length >= 1 ? 'Análise' : 'Pendente') as ItemStatus
            };
            
            // 3. Save to Database (Async, don't block UI)
            sendToDatabase({ 
                action: 'save_item', 
                data: { itemId: item.id, eventId: event.id, photo: newPhoto } 
            });

            onUpdateItem(newItemState);
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    };

    const handleFinishItem = () => {
        if (confirm("Deseja encerrar este item?")) {
            onUpdateItem({ ...item, status: 'Concluído' });
            onBack();
        }
    };

    const handlePrevImage = () => {
        if (viewingPhotoIndex !== null && viewingPhotoIndex > 0) {
            setViewingPhotoIndex(viewingPhotoIndex - 1);
        }
    };

    const handleNextImage = () => {
        if (viewingPhotoIndex !== null && viewingPhotoIndex < item.photos.length - 1) {
            setViewingPhotoIndex(viewingPhotoIndex + 1);
        }
    };
    
    // Helper to get current viewing photo safely
    const viewingPhoto = viewingPhotoIndex !== null ? item.photos[viewingPhotoIndex] : null;

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f8f9fa] flex flex-col font-sans relative">
            
            {/* Image Viewer Carousel Modal */}
            {viewingPhoto && (
                <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black flex flex-col items-center justify-center animate-in fade-in duration-200">
                    <button 
                        onClick={() => setViewingPhotoIndex(null)}
                        className="absolute top-6 right-6 p-2 bg-white/10 rounded-full hover:bg-white/20 transition-colors z-50"
                    >
                        <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-white text-[24px]">close</span>
                    </button>

                    <div className="w-full flex-1 flex items-center justify-between px-2 relative">
                         {item.photos.length > 1 && (
                             <button 
                                onClick={handlePrevImage}
                                disabled={viewingPhotoIndex === 0}
                                className={`p-3 rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 transition-all ${viewingPhotoIndex === 0 ? 'opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed' : 'opacity-100'} z-20`}
                             >
                                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-white text-[32px]">chevron_left</span>
                             </button>
                         )}

                         <div className="flex-1 h-full flex items-center justify-center p-4 relative">
                             <img 
                                src={viewingPhoto.url} 
                                className="max-h-[80vh] max-w-full object-contain rounded-lg shadow-2xl" 
                                alt="View"
                             />
                             
                             {/* OVERLAY MASK - Event Info, Location, Date */}
                             {/* Logic: Only show if at least one metadata exists */}
                             {(viewingPhoto.timestamp || viewingPhoto.coords) && (
                                <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full p-6 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/50 to-transparent text-white z-10 rounded-b-lg">
                                    <h3 className="font-bold text-lg leading-tight mb-1">{event.title}</h3>
                                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs font-medium opacity-90">
                                        {viewingPhoto.coords && (
                                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">location_on</span>
                                                {viewingPhoto.coords}
                                            </span>
                                        )}
                                        {viewingPhoto.timestamp && (
                                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">calendar_today</span>
                                                {viewingPhoto.timestamp}
                                            </span>
                                        )}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                             )}
                         </div>

                         {item.photos.length > 1 && (
                             <button 
                                onClick={handleNextImage}
                                disabled={viewingPhotoIndex === item.photos.length - 1}

                             >
                                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-white text-[32px]">chevron_right</span>

const App = () => {
  const [view, setView] = useState<'login' | 'list' | 'detail' | 'item'>('login');
  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState<Event | null>(null);
  const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState<Item | null>(null);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<any>(null);

  // Initialize with EMPTY items (waiting for base upload) for the main event to demo the feature
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Item[]>([]);

  const handleLogin = () => {
      setUser({ name: 'Produtor', email: 'produtor@valiant.com' });
      setView('list');
  };
  
  const handleLogout = () => {
      setUser(null);
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('login');
  };

  const handleSelectEvent = (evt: Event) => {
      // Logic to switch items based on event ID
      if (evt.id === 'cx-2025') {
          // Initialize empty to show the "Load Base" feature
          setItems([]);
      } else {
          setItems(INITIAL_EMPTY_ITEMS);
      }
      setSelectedEvent(evt);
      setView('detail');
  };
  
  const handleUpdateEvent = (updatedEvent: Event) => {
      setSelectedEvent(updatedEvent);
      // In a real app, you would also update the list of events here
  };
  
  const handleUpdateItems = (newItems: Item[]) => {
      setItems(newItems);
  };

  const handleSelectItem = (item: Item) => {
      if (item.status === 'Concluído') return; 
      setSelectedItem(item);
      setView('item');
  };

  const handleUpdateItem = (updated: Item) => {
      const newItems = items.map(i => i.id === updated.id ? updated : i);
      setItems(newItems);
      setSelectedItem(updated);
  };

  const handleBackToDetail = () => {
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('detail');
  };

  const handleBackToList = () => {
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setView('list');
  };

  return (
    <div className="font-sans text-slate-900">
       {view === 'login' && <Login onLogin={handleLogin} />}
       {view === 'list' && <EventList onSelectEvent={handleSelectEvent} onLogout={handleLogout} />}
       {view === 'detail' && selectedEvent && (
           <EventDetail 
                event={selectedEvent} 
                items={items} 
                onBack={handleBackToList}
                onSelectItem={handleSelectItem}
                onUpdateEvent={handleUpdateEvent}
                onUpdateItems={handleUpdateItems}
           />
       )}
       {view === 'item' && selectedItem && selectedEvent && (
           <ItemDetail 
                item={selectedItem} 
                event={selectedEvent}
                onBack={handleBackToDetail}
                onUpdateItem={handleUpdateItem}
           />
       )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default App;

// 1. Login Component
const Login = ({ onLogin }: { onLogin: () => void }) => {
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  const handleLogin = async () => {
    if (!email || !password) {
        setError('Preencha usuário e senha');
        return;
    }
    
    // Simulação de verificação. No ambiente real, validaria com o backend.
    if (password.length > 3) {
        // Enviar log de acesso ao DB
        sendToDatabase({ action: 'login', data: { email, timestamp: new Date() } });
        onLogin();
    } else {
        setError('Senha inválida');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col justify-center items-center min-h-screen bg-slate-50 p-6 font-sans">
        <div className="w-full max-w-sm flex flex-col items-center">
        <div className="mb-10 flex items-center justify-center">
            {/* Logo Increased 20-25% via scale-125 */}
            <img 
                src="https://agenciavaliant.sharepoint.com/:i:/s/Valiant/IQBAV-hO19qzQp5gb-AKdxgyAXJqj3lOVu7uGcfYxkMfF9k?e=Ridr6f&download=1" 
                alt="Valiant" 
                className="h-24 w-auto object-contain transform scale-125"
            />
        </div>
        
        <div className="text-center mb-10">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-900 mb-2">Valiant. Report</h1>
            <p className="text-slate-500 text-sm">ÁREA RESTRITA</p>
        </div>

        <div className="w-full bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-card border border-slate-100 overflow-hidden p-6 space-y-6">
            <div>
                <label className="block text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider mb-2">Usuário</label>
                <div className="relative">
                <span className="material-symbols-outlined absolute left-4 top-3.5 text-slate-400 text-[20px]">person</span>
                <input 
                    type="email" 
                    placeholder="usuario@valiant.com" 
                    value={email}
                    onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                    className="pl-12 block w-full rounded-xl border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 text-slate-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-800 focus:border-slate-800 text-sm py-3.5 transition-all" 
                />

    const [discrepancyData, setDiscrepancyData] = useState<{count: number, reason: string} | null>(null);

    // Image Viewer State
    const [viewingPhotoIndex, setViewingPhotoIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

    const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

    const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
            processImage(e.target.files[0]);
        }
    };
    
    // Função para obter GPS se necessário
    const getGPSCoordinates = (): Promise<string> => {
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            if (!navigator.geolocation) {
                resolve("GPS não suportado");
                return;
            }
            navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                (position) => {
                    resolve(`${position.coords.latitude.toFixed(5)}, ${position.coords.longitude.toFixed(5)}`);
                },
                (error) => {
                    resolve("Erro GPS");
                },
                { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 5000, maximumAge: 0 }
            );
        });
    };

    const processImage = async (file: File) => {
        setDiscrepancyData(null);
        
        // 1. Determine Location String based on User Preference
        let finalLocation = undefined;
        if (includeGeo) {
            if (customLocation.trim().length > 0) {
                // User typed something, use it
                finalLocation = customLocation;
            } else {
                // User didn't type, fetch GPS
                finalLocation = await getGPSCoordinates();
            }
        }
        
        // 2. Read File
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onloadend = async () => {
            const base64 = reader.result as string;

            const newPhoto: Photo = {
                id: Date.now().toString(),
                url: base64,
                isVerified: true, 
                hasWarning: false,
                timestamp: includeTimestamp ? new Date().toLocaleString() : undefined,
                coords: finalLocation
            };

            const updatedPhotos = [...item.photos, newPhoto];
            const newItemState = {
                ...item,
                photos: updatedPhotos,
                status: (updatedPhotos.length >= 1 ? 'Análise' : 'Pendente') as ItemStatus
            };
            
            // 3. Save to Database (Async, don't block UI)
            sendToDatabase({ 
                action: 'save_item', 
                data: { itemId: item.id, eventId: event.id, photo: newPhoto } 
            });

            onUpdateItem(newItemState);
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    };

                             >
                                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-white text-[32px]">chevron_left</span>
                             </button>

                         <div className="flex-1 h-full flex items-center justify-center p-4 relative">
                             <img 
                                src={viewingPhoto.url} 
                                className="max-h-[80vh] max-w-full object-contain rounded-lg shadow-2xl" 
                                alt="View"
                             />
                             
                             {/* OVERLAY MASK - Event Info, Location, Date */}
                             {/* Logic: Only show if at least one metadata exists */}
                             {(viewingPhoto.timestamp || viewingPhoto.coords) && (
                                <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full p-6 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/50 to-transparent text-white z-10 rounded-b-lg">
                                    <h3 className="font-bold text-lg leading-tight mb-1">{event.title}</h3>
                                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs font-medium opacity-90">
                                        {viewingPhoto.coords && (
                                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">location_on</span>
                                                {viewingPhoto.coords}
                                            </span>
                                        )}
                                        {viewingPhoto.timestamp && (
                                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">calendar_today</span>
                                                {viewingPhoto.timestamp}
                                            </span>

                             )}
                         </div>

                         {item.photos.length > 1 && (

                             >

const App = () => {
  const [view, setView] = useState<'login' | 'list' | 'detail' | 'item'>('login');
  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState<Event | null>(null);
  const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState<Item | null>(null);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<any>(null);

  // Initialize with EMPTY items (waiting for base upload) for the main event to demo the feature
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Item[]>([]);

  const handleLogin = () => {
      setUser({ name: 'Produtor', email: 'produtor@valiant.com' });
      setView('list');
  };
  
  const handleLogout = () => {
      setUser(null);
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('login');
  };

  const handleSelectEvent = (evt: Event) => {
      // Logic to switch items based on event ID
      if (evt.id === 'cx-2025') {
          // Initialize empty to show the "Load Base" feature
          setItems([]);
      } else {
          setItems(INITIAL_EMPTY_ITEMS);
      }
      setSelectedEvent(evt);
      setView('detail');
  };
  
  const handleUpdateEvent = (updatedEvent: Event) => {
      setSelectedEvent(updatedEvent);
      // In a real app, you would also update the list of events here
  };
  
  const handleUpdateItems = (newItems: Item[]) => {
      setItems(newItems);
  };

  const handleSelectItem = (item: Item) => {
      if (item.status === 'Concluído') return; 
      setSelectedItem(item);
      setView('item');
  };

  const handleUpdateItem = (updated: Item) => {
      const newItems = items.map(i => i.id === updated.id ? updated : i);
      setItems(newItems);
      setSelectedItem(updated);
  };

  const handleBackToDetail = () => {
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('detail');
  };

  const handleBackToList = () => {
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setView('list');
  };

  return (
    <div className="font-sans text-slate-900">
       {view === 'login' && <Login onLogin={handleLogin} />}
       {view === 'list' && <EventList onSelectEvent={handleSelectEvent} onLogout={handleLogout} />}
       {view === 'detail' && selectedEvent && (
           <EventDetail 
                event={selectedEvent} 
                items={items} 
                onBack={handleBackToList}
                onSelectItem={handleSelectItem}
                onUpdateEvent={handleUpdateEvent}
                onUpdateItems={handleUpdateItems}
           />
       )}
       {view === 'item' && selectedItem && selectedEvent && (
           <ItemDetail 
                item={selectedItem} 
                event={selectedEvent}
                onBack={handleBackToDetail}
                onUpdateItem={handleUpdateItem}
           />
       )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default App;

// 4. Item Detail & Camera Component
const ItemDetail = ({ item, event, onBack, onUpdateItem }: { item: Item, event: Event, onBack: () => void, onUpdateItem: (updated: Item) => void }) => {
    // analyzing state removed from UI usage basically
    const [includeTimestamp, setIncludeTimestamp] = useState(true);
    const [includeGeo, setIncludeGeo] = useState(false);
    const [customLocation, setCustomLocation] = useState<string>("Salão Principal"); // Default manual location
    
    // UI States for Discrepancy
    const [discrepancyData, setDiscrepancyData] = useState<{count: number, reason: string} | null>(null);

    // Image Viewer State
    const [viewingPhotoIndex, setViewingPhotoIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);

    const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

    const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        if (e.target.files && e.target.files[0]) {
            processImage(e.target.files[0]);
        }
    };
    
    // Função para obter GPS se necessário
    const getGPSCoordinates = (): Promise<string> => {
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            if (!navigator.geolocation) {
                resolve("GPS não suportado");
                return;
            }
            navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(
                (position) => {
                    resolve(`${position.coords.latitude.toFixed(5)}, ${position.coords.longitude.toFixed(5)}`);
                },
                (error) => {
                    resolve("Erro GPS");
                },
                { enableHighAccuracy: true, timeout: 5000, maximumAge: 0 }
            );
        });
    };

    const processImage = async (file: File) => {
        setDiscrepancyData(null);
        
        // 1. Determine Location String based on User Preference
        let finalLocation = undefined;
        if (includeGeo) {
            if (customLocation.trim().length > 0) {
                // User typed something, use it
                finalLocation = customLocation;
            } else {
                // User didn't type, fetch GPS
                finalLocation = await getGPSCoordinates();
            }
        }
        
        // 2. Read File
        const reader = new FileReader();
        reader.onloadend = async () => {
            const base64 = reader.result as string;

            const newPhoto: Photo = {
                id: Date.now().toString(),
                url: base64,
                isVerified: true, 
                hasWarning: false,
                timestamp: includeTimestamp ? new Date().toLocaleString() : undefined,
                coords: finalLocation
            };

            const updatedPhotos = [...item.photos, newPhoto];
            const newItemState = {
                ...item,
                photos: updatedPhotos,
                status: (updatedPhotos.length >= 1 ? 'Análise' : 'Pendente') as ItemStatus
            };
            
            // 3. Save to Database (Async, don't block UI)
            sendToDatabase({ 
                action: 'save_item', 
                data: { itemId: item.id, eventId: event.id, photo: newPhoto } 
            });

            onUpdateItem(newItemState);
        };
        reader.readAsDataURL(file);
    };

    const handleFinishItem = () => {
        if (confirm("Deseja encerrar este item?")) {
            onUpdateItem({ ...item, status: 'Concluído' });
            onBack();
        }
    };

    const handlePrevImage = () => {
        if (viewingPhotoIndex !== null && viewingPhotoIndex > 0) {
            setViewingPhotoIndex(viewingPhotoIndex - 1);
        }
    };

    const handleNextImage = () => {
        if (viewingPhotoIndex !== null && viewingPhotoIndex < item.photos.length - 1) {
            setViewingPhotoIndex(viewingPhotoIndex + 1);
        }
    };
    
    // Helper to get current viewing photo safely
    const viewingPhoto = viewingPhotoIndex !== null ? item.photos[viewingPhotoIndex] : null;

    return (
        <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#f8f9fa] flex flex-col font-sans relative">
            
            {/* Image Viewer Carousel Modal */}
            {viewingPhoto && (
                <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black flex flex-col items-center justify-center animate-in fade-in duration-200">
                    <button 
                        onClick={() => setViewingPhotoIndex(null)}
                        className="absolute top-6 right-6 p-2 bg-white/10 rounded-full hover:bg-white/20 transition-colors z-50"
                    >
                        <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-white text-[24px]">close</span>
                    </button>

                    <div className="w-full flex-1 flex items-center justify-between px-2 relative">
                         {item.photos.length > 1 && (
                             <button 
                                onClick={handlePrevImage}
                                disabled={viewingPhotoIndex === 0}
                                className={`p-3 rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 transition-all ${viewingPhotoIndex === 0 ? 'opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed' : 'opacity-100'} z-20`}
                             >
                                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-white text-[32px]">chevron_left</span>
                             </button>
                         )}

                         <div className="flex-1 h-full flex items-center justify-center p-4 relative">
                             <img 
                                src={viewingPhoto.url} 
                                className="max-h-[80vh] max-w-full object-contain rounded-lg shadow-2xl" 
                                alt="View"
                             />
                             
                             {/* OVERLAY MASK - Event Info, Location, Date */}
                             {/* Logic: Only show if at least one metadata exists */}
                             {(viewingPhoto.timestamp || viewingPhoto.coords) && (
                                <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 w-full p-6 bg-gradient-to-t from-black/90 via-black/50 to-transparent text-white z-10 rounded-b-lg">
                                    <h3 className="font-bold text-lg leading-tight mb-1">{event.title}</h3>
                                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-xs font-medium opacity-90">
                                        {viewingPhoto.coords && (
                                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">location_on</span>
                                                {viewingPhoto.coords}
                                            </span>
                                        )}
                                        {viewingPhoto.timestamp && (
                                            <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                                                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[14px]">calendar_today</span>
                                                {viewingPhoto.timestamp}
                                            </span>
                                        )}
                                    </div>
                                </div>
                             )}
                         </div>

                         {item.photos.length > 1 && (
                             <button 
                                onClick={handleNextImage}
                                disabled={viewingPhotoIndex === item.photos.length - 1}
                                className={`p-3 rounded-full bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 transition-all ${viewingPhotoIndex === item.photos.length - 1 ? 'opacity-30 cursor-not-allowed' : 'opacity-100'} z-20`}
                             >
                                <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-white text-[32px]">chevron_right</span>
                             </button>
                         )}
                    </div>
                    
                    {/* Caption/Counter */}
                    <div className="pb-8 pt-4 text-center">
                        <p className="text-white/80 text-sm font-medium">
                            {viewingPhotoIndex + 1} de {item.photos.length}
                        </p>
                    </div>

            )}

            {/* Header */}

                    <button onClick={onBack} className="p-2 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-full">
                        <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-slate-700">arrow_back_ios_new</span>
                    </button>
                    <div>
                        <p className="text-[10px] font-bold text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wide">ITEM #{item.id}</p>
                        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900 truncate max-w-[200px]">{item.name}</h2>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <button className="p-2 hover:bg-slate-50 rounded-full">
                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-slate-700">more_vert</span>
                </button>
            </header>

            <div className="flex-1 p-5 pb-32 overflow-y-auto">
                
                {/* Updated Item Summary - "Resumo do Contrato" Removed, Image Removed, Added Qty/Daily */}

                    disabled={item.photos.length === 0}
                    className="w-full bg-slate-800 text-white font-bold py-4 rounded-xl shadow-lg shadow-slate-900/10 hover:bg-slate-900 disabled:opacity-50 disabled:shadow-none transition-all flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                >
                    <span className="material-symbols-outlined text-[20px]">check</span>
                    Salvar e Continuar
                </button>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

// --- Main App Component ---

const App = () => {
  const [view, setView] = useState<'login' | 'list' | 'detail' | 'item'>('login');
  const [selectedEvent, setSelectedEvent] = useState<Event | null>(null);
  const [selectedItem, setSelectedItem] = useState<Item | null>(null);
  const [user, setUser] = useState<any>(null);

  // Initialize with EMPTY items (waiting for base upload) for the main event to demo the feature
  const [items, setItems] = useState<Item[]>([]);

  const handleLogin = () => {
      setUser({ name: 'Produtor', email: 'produtor@valiant.com' });
      setView('list');
  };
  
  const handleLogout = () => {
      setUser(null);
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('login');
  };

  const handleSelectEvent = (evt: Event) => {
      // Logic to switch items based on event ID
      if (evt.id === 'cx-2025') {
          // Initialize empty to show the "Load Base" feature
          setItems([]);
      } else {
          setItems(INITIAL_EMPTY_ITEMS);
      }
      setSelectedEvent(evt);
      setView('detail');
  };
  
  const handleUpdateEvent = (updatedEvent: Event) => {
      setSelectedEvent(updatedEvent);
      // In a real app, you would also update the list of events here
  };
  
  const handleUpdateItems = (newItems: Item[]) => {
      setItems(newItems);
  };

  const handleSelectItem = (item: Item) => {
      if (item.status === 'Concluído') return; 
      setSelectedItem(item);
      setView('item');
  };

  const handleUpdateItem = (updated: Item) => {
      const newItems = items.map(i => i.id === updated.id ? updated : i);
      setItems(newItems);
      setSelectedItem(updated);
  };

  const handleBackToDetail = () => {
      setSelectedItem(null);
      setView('detail');
  };

  const handleBackToList = () => {
      setSelectedEvent(null);
      setView('list');
  };

  return (
    <div className="font-sans text-slate-900">
       {view === 'login' && <Login onLogin={handleLogin} />}
       {view === 'list' && <EventList onSelectEvent={handleSelectEvent} onLogout={handleLogout} />}
       {view === 'detail' && selectedEvent && (
           <EventDetail 
                event={selectedEvent} 
                items={items} 
                onBack={handleBackToList}
                onSelectItem={handleSelectItem}
                onUpdateEvent={handleUpdateEvent}
                onUpdateItems={handleUpdateItems}
           />
       )}
       {view === 'item' && selectedItem && selectedEvent && (
           <ItemDetail 
                item={selectedItem} 
                event={selectedEvent}
                onBack={handleBackToDetail}
                onUpdateItem={handleUpdateItem}
           />
       )}
    </div>
  );
};

export default App;

Aqui está o passo a passo exato do que você precisa fazer no seu computador:

### Passo 1: Preparar o Projeto no seu Computador

Você precisa ter o **Node.js** instalado. Abra seu terminal (Prompt de comando ou Terminal) e execute:

1.  **Crie a pasta do projeto:**
    ```bash
    npm create vite@latest valiant-report -- --template react-ts
    ```
2.  **Entre na pasta e instale as dependências:**
    ```bash
    cd valiant-report
    npm install
    ```
3.  **Instale o Tailwind CSS e a biblioteca do Google AI:**
    ```bash
    npm install -D tailwindcss postcss autoprefixer
    npx tailwindcss init -p
    npm install @google/genai
    ```

### Passo 2: Configurar os Arquivos (Copiar e Colar)

Agora, abra essa pasta `valiant-report` no seu editor de código (VS Code) e faça as seguintes alterações nos arquivos que foram criados automaticamente:

1.  **`tailwind.config.js`**: Apague o conteúdo e cole o código abaixo para configurar as cores:
    ```javascript
    /** @type {import('tailwindcss').Config} */
    export default {
      content: [
        "./index.html",
        "./src/**/*.{js,ts,jsx,tsx}",
      ],
      theme: {
        extend: {
          colors: {
            slate: {
                50: '#f8fafc', 100: '#f1f5f9', 200: '#e2e8f0', 300: '#cbd5e1',

                800: '#1e293b', 900: '#0f172a',
            },
          },
          fontFamily: { sans: ["Inter", "sans-serif"] },
        },
      },
      plugins: [],
    }
    ```

2.  **`src/index.css`**: Apague tudo e cole:
    ```css
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700&display=swap');
    @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Material+Symbols+Outlined:wght,FILL@100..700,0..1&display=swap');
    @tailwind base;
    @tailwind components;
    @tailwind utilities;
    body { background-color: #f8fafc; }
    .material-symbols-outlined { font-variation-settings: 'FILL' 0, 'wght' 400, 'GRAD' 0, 'opsz' 24; }
    ```

3.  **Organize os arquivos do App:**
    *   Crie um arquivo **`src/types.ts`** e cole o conteúdo do `types.ts` fornecido.
    *   Crie uma pasta **`src/services`** e dentro dela crie **`api.ts`** (cole o código fornecido) e **`geminiService.ts`** (cole o código fornecido).
    *   Atualize o **`src/App.tsx`** com todo o código principal do aplicativo.

### Passo 3: Colocar no GitHub

Para publicar na Vercel, o código precisa estar na nuvem.

1.  Crie uma conta no [GitHub.com](https://github.com) e crie um novo repositório chamado `valiant-report`.
2.  No terminal do seu projeto, rode:
    ```bash
    git init
    git add .
    git commit -m "Primeira versão"
    git branch -M main
    git remote add origin https://github.com/SEU_USUARIO/valiant-report.git
    git push -u origin main
    ```
    *(Troque `SEU_USUARIO` pelo seu nome de usuário no GitHub)*

### Passo 4: Publicar na Vercel (Hospedagem)

1.  Acesse [vercel.com](https://vercel.com) e faça login com seu GitHub.
2.  Clique em **"Add New..."** -> **"Project"**.
3.  Você verá o repositório `valiant-report`. Clique em **Import**.
4.  Clique em **Deploy**.

Em cerca de 1 minuto, a Vercel vai te dar um link (ex: `https://valiant-report.vercel.app`). **Este é o link que você enviará para todos.**

### Passo 5: Banco de Dados Compartilhado (Crucial)

Você mencionou: *"que qualquer pessoas ao acessar vai ver as mesmas informações"*.

Atualmente, seu código em `App.tsx` usa **estado local** (`useState`) para exibir os itens. Isso significa que se a Pessoa A tirar uma foto, a Pessoa B **não verá** essa foto imediatamente no celular dela, a menos que os dados sejam carregados do banco de dados ao iniciar o app.

O seu arquivo `services/api.ts` já está enviando os dados para um **Google Apps Script**. Para garantir que todos vejam a mesma coisa, você precisa garantir que seu Google Script tenha uma função `doGet` que retorne todos os itens salvos, e precisamos adicionar um pequeno código no `App.tsx` para baixar esses dados ao abrir o app.

**Resumo da arquitetura:**
*   **Frontend:** Vercel (onde o usuário acessa).
*   **Fotos:** São convertidas em Base64 (texto) e enviadas para o script (Nota: para produção pesada, fotos em Base64 podem deixar a planilha lenta. O ideal seria salvar no Google Drive e salvar apenas o Link na planilha, mas para começar funciona).
*   **Dados:** Ficam na Planilha Google vinculada ao seu Script.

Se precisar que eu ajuste o código do `App.tsx` para tentar **ler** os dados da sua API ao iniciar (ao invés de começar zerado), me avise! Caso contrário, seguindo os passos acima, seu app já estará acessível via link para qualquer pessoa.
